title: HPC-DAT Bring-your-own-problem hackathon
body:
# Bring-Your-Own-Problem Hackathon

**Bring your problem, explore solutions, and move your workflow forward.**

We’re happy to announce our next bring-your-own-problem hackathon!

## When & where

- **Dates:** 23, 24 & 26 November 2026
- **Venue:** Netherlands eScience Center, Matrix III
- **Address:** Science Park, 1098 XG, Amsterdam

## What would you like to work on?

- **Scale up with Dask:** Get support with scaling your analysis or workflow.
- **Run your analysis on HPC:** Explore how to use the RS-DAT framework.
- **Discuss Python workflows:** Exchange ideas about interactive Python and Python-based workflows on HPC.

## Join us!

You’re welcome to attend **any or all of the three days**. Bring your questions, challenges, and ideas!

---

**Registration will open shortly.** A registration link will be added here.
